timing_scope: Resident-input host submit/finish wall and diagnostic process CPU (CLOCK_PROCESS_CPUTIME_ID, all process threads); excludes preparation/upload and full-image readback; not GPU kernel time or player frame time.
metadata_scope: Original metadata only; no synthetic or real-media RPU transitions.
output_scope: Original A cross-mode output hashes privately verified equal per frame; no fixture hashes or raw output published.
cpu_reference: Native integer CPU composer, not licensed Dolby hardware.
kodi_state: inactive, no actual Kodi process, no RPC idle claim
frequency_scope: Read-only actual/requested MHz endpoints before and after submissions; not time-weighted or exclusive kernel frequency; reading may perturb scheduling/power.
